data.long_meaning: Nazli is a Persian name that means 'delicate' or 'tender'. It is a popular name in many Muslim cultures, symbolizing the gentle and caring nature of the person. The name Nazli carries the meaning “Delicate, Tender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nazli usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, tender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
